title: 任务界面与用户审查
scope: 有限候选、实例、规则检查及历史的审阅呈现；本机app装配显式采纳、离线回答下载与应用配置准备/确认/保存。无自动候选生成、业务CommandBinding或完整Studio。

dependency_semantics.implementation: Design-only public CommandBinding consumption; finite candidate review does not import or execute an implementation backend.

implemented_scope: Standard-library-only finite review presentation/static resources and unconfigured application-spec structure. Exact integer/rule/project/spec text remains server-produced; explicit instance checks, proposal adoption and history are composed by the app through A public interfaces. Offline revision download and configuration preview/confirmation/save remain distinct from generation, runtime acceptance and semantic fidelity. No model state ownership, automatic model calls or authentication service.
